Ridges and Tops

Source: R/ridges_tops.R
ridges_tops.Rd

Detects different types of ridges and tops, based on Silveira and Silveira (2020). The primary difference is the use of a rectangular local neighborhood shape instead of a circular one, in the calculation of the White Top Hat (WTH) (Rodriguez et al., 2002). For more satisfactory results, it is recommended to define the moving window based on the minimum mappable area.

Usage

ridges_tops(x, sp_range, type)

Arguments

x

Input DEM raster

type

Each number represents a specific landform, for example: (1) Convex hilltops and Interfluves, (2) Sharp crests, and (3) Ridges

w

Number of cells for the window size

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
library(terra)
library(slope)
dem <- terra:rast(system.file("ex/elev.tif", package = "terra"))
r <- slope::ridges_tops(dem, 7, 1)
plot(r)
} # }
